easyPrerequisites: Faceless Butcher must be exiled by Glorious Protector, and Abdel Adrian must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
description:
Cast Abdel Adrian for its mana cost.
When Abdel Adrian enters, it exiles Glorious Protector until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Abdel Adrian's ETB.
When Glorious Protector leaves the battlefield, Faceless Butcher is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Faceless Butcher enters, it exiles Abdel Adrian until Faceless Butcher leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Faceless Butcher's ETB.
When Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, Glorious Protector is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Glorious Protector enters, it exiles Faceless Butcher until Glorious Protector leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Glorious Protector's ETB.
When Faceless Butcher leaves the battlefield, Abdel Adrian is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
